stays: `r = -1; p->result = r; return r;` the ROM keeps one -1 in r5 for the store and the return; two literals get two registers
raw 0x14 skip into the palette resource
`*&index` in the first glyph call: without it the index gets a register and the loop allocation changes
score pointer before storing clockDisplayValue: a direct member store changes the whole allocation
the odd negative shift looks like an original signed-divide macro
goto into the other branch plus pendingKeys/repeatMask locals: the plain form is 2 insns off (the ROM loads the zero before storing the key word)
position pointer: separate member stores compute the address twice
graphics, table and digit pointers: invariant addresses must be allocated in this order
Bg_DisableDisplay/Bg_EnableDisplay flag accessors: plain &= and |= on gDispCntShadow store twice differently
label pointer: a direct member update computes the address differently
`value` holds the mask then the flag word pointer, with FlagIsSet/SetFlag: the ROM materializes the mask before the flag address and shares that address; plain tests are 5+ insns off
count doubles as the destination address: an indexed loop is 12 insns off (no loop reversal, source base add swaps); pointer loops hoist the pointer setup above the width test
stripOffset also holds drawnX: a separate local lets the switch value take r1 and the per-case offset constants disappear (10 insns); cursorX = rightEdge steers cross-jumping
